name: qimgv
description:
qimgv is a fast, configurable image viewer written in Qt5/Qt6 with optional video playback support. Designed for speed and minimal UI clutter, it allows effortless browsing through large photo libraries and comic archives.

Features:
- Fast image caching and hardware-accelerated rendering
- Video playback support (powered by mpv) for MP4, WebM, and animated GIFs
- Customizable thumbnail bar with directory navigation and folder jumping
- Image manipulation tools including lossless rotation, cropping, and resizing
- Integrated file management and custom shell command trigger scripts
